The First Page.

I’ve decided to start a extremely bare-bones blog.

Why?

I don’t know, I thought it might be cool to have something where I can just say stuff about something. Most likely, the blog will have 1-2 post(s) a month, because either I don’t have anything to type about, I forget about it, or I didn’t want to type about something.

RSS feeds may be implemented at some point.
